notes.title: July 23rd, Maintenance Reschedule Notice
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3e7y3uH.png[/img]


[h1][u][u][b]iRO Maintenance Reschedule[/b][/u][/u][/h1]


[b]July 23rd, 2024 to July 25th, 2024[/b]



Hello, Adventurers.



As you are aware, the recent Global BSOD event affected a lot of computer networks, our servers included.



While the servers are currently up and running again, further adjustments are needed to ensure the stability of our servers. And in light of this event, [b]we will reschedule this week's maintenance to Thursday, July 25th 2024 10:00 PDT.[/b]



 



We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may cause, and we appreciate your support.

notes.title: Important Notice Regarding the Recent System Exploit Issue
notes.content:
[u][b]Important Notice Regarding the Recent System Exploit Issue[/b][/u]

 

Hello,

This is the Ragnarok Online management team.

We would like to inform you about the recent issue that occurred in game.

 

[b]Details of the issue:[/b]

We have discovered that items and zeny were acquired unfairly through unauthorized activities by a certain number of accounts.

 

[b]Action taken:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]System vulnerability correction [/b][/*][/list]
We have applied a new build to prevent the issue during normal weekly maintenance on Tuesday, February 20, 2024.
[list]	[*][b] Affected accounts[/b][/*][/list]
Permanent suspension of all accounts that exploited the system vulnerabilities.
[list]	[*][b]Affected items and Zeny[/b][/*][/list]
Thorough investigation and recovery of all items and Zeny from related accounts.

 

However, due to necessary care and time required to track the movement of both Zeny and the items, there are a number of accounts that are still temporarily suspended at the moment.

Please understand that due to the large amount of data being investigated, this process will take some time.

 

Furthermore, we have confirmed that the above issue does not occur during normal gameplay unless the user performs very specific odd behavior to perform the exploit.

Please be careful not to get involved with suspicious transactions or characters.

If you feel your account might be affected by this issue, please kindly contact the support team.

 

Additionally, since this issue was occurring in many other regions as well, we were unable to provide further details until the fix was implemented in all service areas.

Lastly, continued periodic and close inspections of the game system will be performed.

We will do our best to prevent this issue from happening in the future.

We apologize for the confusion and inconvenience caused to our users.

 

Thank you

Ragnarok Online Team

[h2]October 14th, 12:00PM - 6:00PM PDT[/h2]

Hey guys, I know many are impatient for the 185 update. Currently it's under going studio's QA. Once it passes, we can schedule a date for it to be brought to live.
 
Additionally, the bonus EXP and drops rates we implemented as compensation for the "Panic" error will revert back to the "Homeward Bound" rates (+50% EXP and +25% Drops).
		
[i]Hardware maintenances will solely consist of IT tasks required to continue smooth operation of the game. From now on, we will be alternating between Hardware Maintenance and Update Maintenance from week to week. Current schedule looks like this:
	
	10/14 - Hardware Maintenance
	10/21 - Update Maintenance 
	10/28 - Hardware Maintenance 
[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 6/24/2021
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2IQbOWi.png[/img]
[h2]June 24th, 12:00PM - 6:00PM PDT[/h2]

[b]Hey Folks,

We will share more details in this week's Good Afternoon thread, but we have a few changes coming to our maintenance schedule for July. We are moving to a bi-weekly update plan for both RT and RO1. There will be weekly maintenances, but the first maintenance will be solely for server restarts and contain no content updates. The second week will be focused on applying more content, bug fixes, and changes. The reason for doing this is to allow for more time to properly test and implement events and schedules.

Currently, we are working on upgrading our testing regime to catch issues, but doing so will require a longer QA process.

On July 8th, RT will be receiving the Popcorn Festa and the systems update. This means guild emblems will be reset on RT on July 8th. After the update, guilds will be able to apply animated emblems. More details will come for this patch at that time.[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 4/22/2021
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/m8AcA4T.png[/img]
[h2]April 22nd, 2:00PM - 6:00PM PDT[/h2]

Hey Folks,
 
Since we are removing Corridor of Phantom this week, I wanted to thank everyone who participated in testing this event. We will be editing the flowers to allow them to be sold to NPCs. We are currently reviewing the data gathered from the event and will be sharing that, along with the feedback in this thread ([b][url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/253383-community-submission-share-your-corridor-of-phantoms-videos/]Link)[/url][/b], with the studio tonight.
 
Overall, we see the main player feedback had several themes.

[olist]
[*] Current Map Settings had a mixed response. It is very unfun to die at map spawn.
[*] In general, rewards were not satisfying for effort and resources invested. Solo or as a group.
[*] High Tier Rewards were so rare that few, if any, players were aware of them.
[*] Balance concerns continue (This will be reflected in log data we gathered)
[/olist]
Please continue to share your feedback and replay files with us over the next few days so we can provide as much information to the studio as we can.

notes.title: Ragnarok Online 12 Days of Christmas Raffle Giveaway!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/e0b12385db2801295a6727cac03b1a355f9531f1.jpg[/img]
 

[h1][b]Ragnarok Online
12 Days of Christmas Raffle Giveaway![/b][/h1]

We're ringing in the holiday season with a raffle event unlike any other!
Hold onto your hats, folks, we've got some cool prizes for you to win!
Starting [b]Thursday, December 14[/b], we'll be drawing raffle prizes [b]every day for 12 days straight![/b]


[h1]Here's how it works:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Each day, we will draw a total of [b]31 daily prizes[/b] from a pool of qualified players[/*]
[*]15 winners will receive the [b]Costume of the Day[/b][/*]
[*]15 winners will receive a code for [b]500 WPE[/b][/*]
[*]1 lucky winner will receive the [b]Daily Big Prize[/b][/*]
[*]At the end of the event, we will draw from all qualifying entries over the course of the event to pick one [b]Grand Prize Winner![/b][/*]
[/LIST]
 
[h1]How to Enter:[/h1]
 
Gaining entries into the daily raffle is easy! All you have to do is qualify in one of two ways:
[LIST]
[*]1 Daily Entry for having VIP active[/*]
[*]1 Entry per 100 Kafra Points spent (per day)[/*]
[/LIST]
That's all! As long as you meet those qualifications on any given day during the event, you automatically have an entry into the raffle and have a shot at winning the prizes!
 

[h1]Daily Prizes[/h1]
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/988564d0ed16c4fd995709f40b619e05eefd8213.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/0e21d43816706d38ef4c959c4a3763f85944571d.png[/img]


[h1]Grand Prize[/h1]
After the event is finished on December 25, we'll pool together [i]all valid entries that existed during the event[/i]and choose one at random to receive our [b]Grand Prize[/b]! 
 
Grand Prize: 
[b]Ragnarok-Themed Bottle & Towel Set[/b]
AND [b]A custom watercolor painting of your character done by JelloShaker![/b] *
* [i]PG-13, waist-up only, 6x6 inches. To be delivered February 2018.[/i]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/4a8dab111a605bea469248dd6839617581394a3e.png[/img]

 
[h1]Event Details[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]The event will start on [b]Thursday, December 15[/b] and end on [b]Monday, December 25[/b].[/*]
[*]To meet the KP qualifications for the daily raffle, KP must be purchased on the [b]same day[/b]. 
Example:
[LIST]
[*]100 KP spent on Day 2 = 1 entry for Day 2 raffle[/*]
[*]200 KP spent on Day 3 = 2 entries for Day 3 raffle[/*]
[*]However, [b]all[/b] those entries will count toward the final drawing for the Grand Prize![/*]
[/LIST]
[/*]
[*]Grand Prize drawing will pull from [b]all entries[/b] during the event period.[/*]
[*]Users may only win [b]one Grand Prize[/b] and [b]One Daily Big Prize[/b] during the event.[/*]
[*]Physical goods (such as the Daily Big Prizes and the Grand Prize) can only be shipped to Canada and continental United States. Should you win one of these prizes from outside the shipping area, you will be given two options:
[LIST]
[*]Pay the shipping costs to receive the physical goods[/*]
[*]Receive an [b]alternate prize:[/b]
[LIST]
[*][b]3000 WPE[/b] as Grand Prize[/*]
[*][b]1000 WPE[/b] as Daily Big Prize[/*]
[/LIST]
[/*]
[/LIST]
[/*]
[*][b]Daily Big Prize[b] winners [/b][/b]and [b][b][b]Grand Prize[/b] winners [/b][/b]will be contacted via email from [b]community@warpportal.com[/b] for shipping information. Please add this email address to your contact list to ensure you receive it if and when the time comes![/*]
[/LIST]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/ebef5d815639fd88adda1d70c9aea75067738e1e.jpg[/img]


[h1]Introducing Tomb of Honor![/h1]

This latest edition to the Bio Labs, Tomb of Honor is Ragnarok Online's highest level dungeon, reserved only for the strongest and bravest of adventurers. If you're up to the challenge, you will be rewarded with exhilirating battles and epic rewards!

Learn more about this update by checking out any of the active links below!

[url=http://www.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=302&p=1][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/6f0bb0fe4f4238a71b5540b54c4964b04c19a019.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=303&p=1][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/729b4ae60f3ba002c6dff67727c29b730e86aa26.png[/img][/url]

In the slums of Lighthalzen, Ohno Tohiro discovered something strange.
It was a crevice situated in an unassuming part of the village. Although the town was no stranger to oddities, the crevice that emitted strange sounds was new. Curious, Ohno Tohiro ventured inside... and immediately scrambled back out. Terrified of what he had seen, he told an adventuring friend of his, who also ventured into the strange crevice.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/ed8a93304ea85e2478ba67f2f1baa47c07841be5.jpg[/img]

A few days later, the adventurer emerged from the crevice badly injured, but alive - and loaded with mysterious, powerful items. Word of his time in the mysterious crevice spread, and soon more adventurers and mercenaries began showing up in hopes of gaining such riches. Unfortunately, they never returned. As quickly as it rose in popularity, the crevice began to grow quieter, with only rumors of its horrors and riches surrounding it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/d273c0f4d6f81fef4194f8c713e853bdde7aeab0.jpg[/img]

Nowadays, Ohno Tohiro can be found at the the entrance to the crevice, claiming ownership over it due to his discovery. His experience with the place has made him wary, and he'll only let in adventurers in exchange for zeny, or strangely enough, research papers. Rumors say that the monsters within have slowly taken the shape of other people, and there are whispers of an old biomedical research lab somehow involved. The crevice is open to only the strongest adventurers eager to test their might, explore new places, and find powerful treasures.

notes.title: Compensation Events + Updates
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/395f1bb0ec50c94569479408cc86e71042cb7d20.jpg[/img]

Hello everybody! A brief announcement from our team with a few updates.

[h1]Compensation Events![/h1]

- Starting today, we're going to be doing a 25% EXP + Drops Extra event until 8/10. Classic server will receive the same from 8/10 - 8/17.

- On 8/10, we will be adding 10 days of VIP to all accounts that had VIP as of 7/25.

- On 8/11, we will be having another 4 day VIP Weekend Event!
[list]
[*]WP Users will need to claim the 4 days once it starts
[*]Steam users will have it automatically inserted once it starts
[/list]

[h1]Other Updates![/h1]

- Cracked Buckler Machine will be returning 8/10 with that rare costume! So this is your chance to get it again.

- Currently we are working on the new Spotlight Quests + A "Talk Like A Pirate Day" quest for both Renewal and Classic servers.

- Nightmare Biolabs (Bed of Honor) is nearing the end of its QA Phase at the Studio.

Have a great weekend everybody!

notes.title: Special Event - Share the Banquet with Ragnarok Online!
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/800w_ShareBanquet.jpg[/img][h1]Share the Banquet with Ragnarok Online[/h1]
[b]Get ready for Episode 16.1 - Banquet for Heroes with a month of sharing & rewards! 
May 1 to June 1[/b]
 
All aboard the hype train! Get ready to usher in Ragnarok Online's latest update, [b]16.1 - Banquet for Heroes[/b]! From May 1 to June 1, journey across the internet to connect with Ragnarok Online for the chance to earn incredible bonuses for all the servers, as well as the chance to win our ultimate Grand Prize! 

 [h1]Your Quest[/h1] 
Log in using Facebook, Twitter, Twitch, or email and complete one or more of the tasks below to earn entries. Every task you complete counts as an entry toward the Grand Prize raffle as well as the server-wide rewards, so make sure to use a valid email address to be eligible for the Grand Prize! 

 [h1]The Grand Prize[/h1] 
Every task you complete in your quest counts as one entry into a raffle to win the following: 
[list][*]30 Days of VIP[/*][*]Choice of any one (1) costume item previously or currently sold in the Cash Shop[/*][*]Two (2) Adventurer's Banquet Boxes (contents listed in server rewards below)[/*][*]Choice of three (3) different Pet Tames[/*][/list] 
At the end of the campaign, five (5) winners will be contacted through email to receive the Grand Prize, so make sure you enter using a valid email address!

 [h1]Rewards for All[/h1] 
When Midgardians work together, everyone wins! Every task completed for the campaign not only counts toward the Grand Prize raffle, but also toward server-wide rewards for all of Rune-Midgard! Gather your companions and rally the realm - there are prizes to be won!
[b]Server-Wide Prizes Include:

2,000 Shares[/b]
+25% EXP and +10% Drops bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

[b]4,000 Shares[/b]
+50% EXP and +20% Drops Bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

[b]6,000 Shares﻿[/b]
NPC Giveaway: Rare Pet Tame grab bag, for one week 

[b]8,000 Shares[/b]
+75% EXP and +30% Drops Bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

[b]10,000 Shares[/b]
The following Costume Boxes return to the Cash Shop for the duration of the campaign: Fluffy Costume Egg, Love Garden Costume Box, Gothic Costume Egg, Anniversary Costume Box, and more! 

[b]13,000 Shares[/b]
+100% EXP and 40% Drops Bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

[b]16,000 Shares[/b]
NPC Giveaway: Pet Skelly Cat, f﻿or one week 

[b]19,000 Shares[/b]
Homunculus Loyalty Event on for duration of campaign 

[b]22,000 Shares[/b]
+125% EXP and 50% Drops Bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

[b]26,000 Shares[/b]
Enriched Hammer Event on for the duration of campaign 

[b]30,000 Shares[/b]
+150% EXP and 60% Drops Bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

[b]35,000 Shares[/b]
Fire Sale NPC on for duration of event (selling previous Overseas Care Packages) 

[b]40,000 Shares[/b]
+175% EXP and 60% Drops Bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

[b]45,000 Shares[/b]
Adventurer's Banquet Box goes on sale for 1000KP in the Cash Shop. Box includes:
[list][*](10) Battle Manual X3[/*] [*](10) HE Bubble Gum [/*][*](5) Bloody Branches[/*][*](20) Increase Agility 10 Scrolls [/*][*](20) Blessing 10 Scrolls [/*][*](5) Kafra Cards [/*][*](20) Greed Scrolls [/*][*](10) Dungeon Teleport Scrolls [/*][*](12) Small Life Potions [/*][*](500) Prize Medal ﻿[/*][*](20) Enriched Oridecon [/*][*](20) Enriched Elunium[/*][/list] 

[b]50,000 Shares[/b]
+200% EXP and 70% Drops Bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 
 
[h1]Begin Your Quest![/h1] 
To enter, please sign in (using Facebook, Twitter, or Email) to the Gleam.io page linked below. Once that's done, you have the opportunity to earn additional entries by connecting with Ragnarok accounts in different social media platforms, including Twitter, Facebook, YouTube, and Twitch. More ways to gain entries will be added over the course of the campaign, so make sure to follow this thread as well as our social media accounts for updated information!

 Once again, please make sure you enter using a valid email address so we have a way of contacting you if you win the raffle for the Grand Prize! 


To enter, please visit the link at the bottom of this forum post!
https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/211111-share-the-banquet-celebrate-161-with-rewards-for-all/
 
Thank you, and best of luck to all!

notes.title: Update regarding the new Philippine Server
notes.content:
Greetings, iRO players! Recently, a few of you have expressed concerns regarding new servers opening in the Southeast Asia region, and we'd like to address that here.

Gravity HQ has confirmed that there is indeed a new server launching for the Philippines and Southeast Asia region. There have been no plans or requests made for us to merge data from Thor to this new server. Players are allowed to continue playing with us and stay with the WarpPortal Family. We want you to know that you are always welcome to play with the friends you have made here, and we look forward to continuing the adventure with you here at iRO as we continue to update our game!

Thank you for your attention, everybody.
Enjoy the rest of your day!

[b]Over the last few weeks, we have been upgrading both our Renewal and Classic server hardware to better machines. notes.title: Good Afternoon 4/3/2017
notes.content:
Welcome to our good afternoon post! We'll be posting these regular updates from our producer Campitor once a week, so be sure to tune in every Monday!

Hey Folks! This week were focusing on bug fixes and preparing updates for all servers. Our CM team spent the weekend hanging out at WonderCon and may have even passed out some fliers. How was everyone else's weekends? Did you do anything interesting?
 
General:
[list]
[*]Kafra Friendship Companion Program opened its doors last weekend.
[*]General dialog clean up
[*]FCC will properly point users to Tomboy's real location
[*]Kafra will give stronger hints as to want item they want.
[*]Different Kafra will be less different and follow through on promises to make a sandwich
[*]Creating a reset option for the FCC if you get stuck at any stage before finishing the event
[*]Kafras will be more clear that you have disappointed them and are unworthy of their companionship at this time.
[*]Alchemist/Blacksmith list resets are coming up at the end of April
[/list]
Renewal

Updates:
[list]
[*]Looking into the Disconnection Issues
[*]Were strengthening the login process as much as we can this maintenance. Were trying another fix during this next maintenance. 
[*]Allowing Doram to use Verus Storage
[*]Unstacking NPCs in Mora
[*]Figuring out why Ponytail Dye npc is refusing to do her job.
[/list]

On Going Sales
[list]
[*]Overseas Care Package
[*]April Costume Box continues
[/list]

​Classic

New Headgear Quest
[list]
[*]Reviewing submitted feedback.
[*]Planning with Ozzalia on what we can do for the next event/update for classic
[*]Moscovia save point will properly save in moscovia
[/list]
Community
[list]
[*]Boxing the Compass can be found here: https://forums.warpp...e-compass-rose/
 [/list]
 
 
Have you tried the KFC quest? What did you think? Would you like similar quests to be written? This one to be expanded on?

[url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/206696-renewal-january-26th-maintenance/]WarpPortal Forums Renewal Maintenance Thread[/url]

notes.title: Episode 15.2: Lost Memories Update Overview
notes.content:
Episode 15.1 and 15.2 introduces a new area to explore and three new instanced dungeons to Ragnarok Online.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/6ee397dd34cde69748583fbdf7a05e17a880bfcf.png[/img]
Verus City
Battle your way through the ruins of the lost city of Verus and help the expedition discover the lost history of this ruined city.

Under Bunker
Something had gone terribly wrong in this bunker. Brave the undead and hostile robots and work your way to the last room.

Charleston Factory
Charleston needs you! Help her recover replacement parts so that she may repair herself. Adventurers who are able to assist will find themselves rewarded with equipment from the Charleston Factory.

Central Laboratory
Travel to the past to witness the disaster that destroyed this lab. If you survive perhaps you will be able to bring some souvenirs back with you.

Last Room
Assist a group of adventurers in discovering what happened to the last of the survivors that sheltered in the Under Bunker. Make sure to hold onto any 'intact machine components' found within as the adventurer 'Fruit' is looking to trade some equipment for them.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/85983a818db468052ecc7662056624194f685f88.jpg[/img]

Crimson Weapon System Update Overview
Monsters from all over the world of Rune Migard have had their inventories checked and equipment updated. Hunt these monsters to find the new powerful Crimson Weapons. Each Crimson Weapon comes with an embedded charm that causes elemental type damage when the weapon is wielded.

Weapon Elemental Charms:
Fire
Earth
Wind
Water
Shadow
Holy
Neutral

notes.title: Steam Login issues *resolved*
notes.content:
Greetings everyone. We received reports over the weekend that the Steam sign on and overlay weren't working properly. This meant manual logins and not being able to purchase points. We have investigated this issue and as of 2:15pm today we have a solution.

1. Please start the game and let it patch fully. Once it has done so exit out of the patcher and restart the game through steam

2. When you start the game a second time it will fix the issue and the single sign on for RO's Steam client will work properly. 

Thank you very much for your patience.

notes.title: Weekly Server Maint. Wednesday 11/6
notes.content:
Our weekly maintenance takes place every Wednesday at 9am PST and lasts until 12 noon. 
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[b]Renewal[/b]
-Fast leveing jump event ends next week
-Eden Group Mission Board turn-in NPCs moved to be closer to the boards where you pick up the missions. 
-October Spooky Box leaves 

Training ground improvements
-Second versions of South Prontera Field and Izlude training grounds are being removed and players on those second versions are being moved to the original maps. No more parallel universe syndrome!
-Non-tamable "Little Poring" NPCs in taming tutorial area being removed and the [Poring] NPC dialog improved to make it more clear what you should be doing. 
-[Battle Instructor] NPC will now teleport you directly to South Prontera Field, so it doesn't take so much walking to get to the fighting. There will be a copy of that NPC added to South Prontera field to teleport players back to the Academy.

-Nifflheim spotlight continues for one more week, Moscovia spotlight begins next week
-Prepping Moscovia for implementation next week
-Kafras returned to normal
-Fixed Payon direct warp when going from the training grounds
-Working on New Classic Training grounds
-Working on God Item and Guild Dungeon 5 project

notes.title: Brief server restart at 4pm PDT
notes.content:
Hello there everyone. We are doing a brief maintenance at 4pm PDT (about 5 hours from this posting) to implement some community requested tweaks and fixes. 

[h1]Changelog: [/h1]

[b]Renewal Chaos: [/b]
-When you are the proper level and have spent all of your skill points, you will be able to speak with the [url=http://www.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=240&p=1]Classroom NPC[/url] to change to your first job from novice.

[b]Classic Loki: [/b]
-White potion healing reverted to values before Wednesday's maintenance.
-Giant flywings disabled in Guild Dungeons
-Blue herbs and cobwebs added to drop list of Guild Supply Box
-Removing Anolian spawns from Clock tower underground map, increasing spawns of other monsters
-Adding option for VIPs to access that level of the dungeon without it consuming keys. 
-Prontera Guild dungeon spawns being adjusted to compensate for large maps size.
